translation:
Pig stomach (豬肚) (one), coptis (黃連) (five liang), Trichosanthes fruit (栝蔞) (four liang), Ophiopogon (麥冬) (four liang, with the heart removed), Anemarrhena (知母) (four liang; if unavailable, substitute with Poria (茯苓)).

Grind the above four ingredients into powder, place into the pig stomach, sew it shut with thread, set it in a steaming vessel, and steam until extremely thoroughly cooked. While hot, pound it in a wooden mortar until it can be formed into pills; if it is hard, add a little honey. Form pills the size of Tongzi (桐子) seeds; take thirty pills each time, gradually increasing to forty pills. Take them when thirsty. If there is no wooden mortar, one may also grind it in a sand basin with a wooden pestle; it is best when thoroughly mashed.
translator_notes: 桐子大 rendered as 'size of Tongzi seeds'.
